instruction: Repair workers.run_jobs(values, workers), which must terminate after squaring each integer input exactly once and return results in original order, without changing values. workers is an integer; values has at most 100 integers. Reject counts outside 1..8 with ValueError, including empty input. Empty input returns [] for a valid count. Clean up every worker and leave no live worker thread after return. The existing queue-based implementation is allowed to be simplified if all specified behavior is preserved; there is no minimum parallel speedup requirement.
